comments.author: Oraceon
comments.body_html: I have noticed an issue with Watch Animations and the Mosin. Sometimes the Watch Animations mod will completely break the mosin and other bolt action rifles, causing the reload animations to be off and firing the weapon to launch the barrel over your shoulder. This issue was present on the last version of Watch Animations, though it does not seem to be as prominent on this version, still happens a few times per raid if you’re running a Mosin or other bolt action rifles. I have tested this with and without the mod installed and can confirm it is this mod doing it. You can recreate this issue by loading into raid with a mosin carbine, like I did, with iron sights. I also had a suppressor but that doesn’t seem to matter. It doesn’t always happen, but sometimes when you loot, check your chamber, or reload the mosin after using the Watch Animations “O” key, it can reliably break Mosin animations. I hope to see this fixed soon! The mod is great and immersive besdies that.
